primary_anchor_zh: 白色身体上的大片黑色斑纹
story_reason_zh: 犬只去庭院水碗处饮水，随后回到软垫

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 安静休息的斑点犬在阳光门廊的大软垫上，安静趴卧并轻缓呼吸。
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 白色身体上的大片黑色斑纹占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由门廊开口缓慢走出画面；随后呈现空软垫和门廊木地板。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由门廊开口缓慢走出画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由门廊开口缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由门廊开口缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新展示主体醒目的白色身体上的大片黑色斑纹；其他属性不作为验收目标。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed medium shot frames a large white dog with broad black patches on a wide cushion beneath a sunlit porch. The dog rests quietly with gentle breathing.

A fixed medium shot shows a large white dog with broad black patches walking slowly through the open side of the porch until the dog leaves the frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty wide cushion and the sunlit wooden porch floor. A sheer curtain beside the porch moves gently.
A fixed medium shot shows a large white dog with broad black patches walking slowly back through the open side of the porch and settling on a wide cushion beneath a sunlit porch.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 主体经由门廊开口缓慢走出画面
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 主体经由门廊开口缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
